name: worker-safety-monitor
description: AI-powered real-time worker safety monitoring — YOLOv8 + DeepSORT + MediaPipe with a React dashboard

scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./frontend" --filter "./api-server" --if-present run typecheck
